svg.title: Power spectrum of the radial velocities of GJ 570 A
svg.desc: The power spectrum of the ESPRESSO velocities of GJ 570 A from five nights in May 2024. Power gathers in a hump around nu max, near 4.7 millihertz: the star's oscillations, with periods of three to four minutes.

a.text: Data: Campante et al. 2026, CC BY 4.0
